# Test fixtures

`radio-geek-002-excerpt.mp3` is a 12-second excerpt (79s–91s, downmixed to mono and
re-encoded) of [Radio Geek #2 — "Space and beyond"](https://archive.org/details/jadi-radio-geek)
by **Jadi** (jadi.net), licensed under
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). The excerpt is distributed
under the same license. It is used by CI to smoke-test decoding and transcription.
